name: Fennel (saunf), whole
ambiguity_note: Sub-heading 090961 covers anise, badian, caraway and fennel, neither crushed nor ground. Six digits meet the invoice rule. The 8-digit item for fennel that is not seed quality has to be read off the current ITC (HS); seed quality of heading 0909 is nil.
source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 41. Seed quality nil: Notification No. 10/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025 (nil / exempt), effective 22 September 2025. Tariff heading 0909.

source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 41.

name: Fenugreek (methi)
ambiguity_note: Fenugreek sits in 091099 (other spices). The 8-digit item has to come from the current ITC (HS). Heading 0910, other than fresh ginger and fresh turmeric, is 5%.
source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 42.

name: Ajwain
ambiguity_note: Ajwain is under 091099 (other spices). Confirm the 8-digit item in the current tariff. The rate for this heading is 5%.

name: Spice mixture (spices only)
phrases:
spice mixture
mixed spices
spice mix
ambiguity_note: 09109100 is mixtures of spices referred to in Chapter 9 Note 1(b). If the blend contains salt or other condiments it is a mixed seasoning under 21039040. Both are 5%.
source: ITC (HS) Chapter 9, Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics (https://www.dgciskol.gov.in/Writereaddata/Downloads/CHP_09.pdf) (09109100). Customs Tariff Chapter 9 Note 1: a mixture of spices stays in Chapter 9 only while it keeps the essential character of those spices. Once salt or other ingredients make it a mixed condiment, it moves to heading 2103. Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entries 42 and 139.

name: Garam masala

Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 139 (2103) and entry 42 (0910).

source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 68 (flour and meals of oil seeds, other than mustard).

name: Besan (gram flour)
phrases:
besan
gram flour
chana flour
chickpea flour
ambiguity_note: Besan of chana is 11061090 (other), not guar meal 11061010, which is nil-rated and is the wrong code. Pre-packaged and labelled besan is 5%. Besan that is not pre-packaged and labelled is nil. A branded SK Gourmet pack is the 5% case. The audit does not change the tax template on its own, because a loose pack and a labelled pack are both lawful.
source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 56. Nil when not pre-packaged and labelled, and guar meal 11061010, under Notification No. 10/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025 (nil / exempt), effective 22 September 2025.

name: Sattu
ambiguity_note: Roasted chana sattu is flour of a dried leguminous vegetable, so 11061090, with the same pre-packaged 5% / loose nil split as besan. Sattu made from a cereal such as barley is heading 1102, again 5% if pre-packaged and labelled and nil otherwise. It is not automatically heading 2106. Confirm the grain on the pack.
source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entries 56 (1106) and 52 (1102). Nil when not pre-packaged and labelled under Notification No. 10/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025 (nil / exempt), effective 22 September 2025.

name: Wheat flour (atta, maida)
phrases:
atta
maida
wheat flour
refined flour
ambiguity_note: Heading 1101. Pre-packaged and labelled wheat flour is 5%. Flour that is not pre-packaged and labelled is nil.
source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 51. Nil when not pre-packaged and labelled under Notification No. 10/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025 (nil / exempt), effective 22 September 2025.

name: Sunkeera
ambiguity_note: Sunkeera products are food supplements under 21069099. Do not use pan masala 21069020. This is a suggestion only. Nothing is written onto the item until you apply it.
source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entry 145.

name: Other wellness
ambiguity_note: The product licence decides the heading. A retail Ayurvedic medicament is heading 3004 at 5%, unless that formulation is in the nil list of Notification 10/2025. A food preparation that is not a medicament is heading 2106, other than pan masala 21069020, also at 5%. Do not use 21069020. The 8-digit item under 3004 has to match the licence.
source: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, Schedule I (5%), effective 22 September 2025, entries 229, 234 and 145.
